The '''9000 Energy Scanner''' was an [[energy scanner]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It could detect the presence of various forms of energy, including [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsor fields]], [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] sources, and communications signals.
